parts:

messages.author: 9892f9c35b87e857
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Show marker positions on figure
parts:
Hi

From Dr. Broman’s earlier reply on March 29, 2019

"R/qtl can provide only simple views of genetic maps. For publication, I would generally modify them by hand with a lot of custom code.
You might look at alternate packages, such as LinkageMapView, https://cran.r-project.org/package=LinkageMapView”

Or there is another reply on June 18, 2019

"You can plot an interactive map with R/qtlcharts (https://kbroman.org/qtlcharts); shows the marker name when you hover, or highlights a marker after you search for it.”

Both mails replied from Dr. Broman. Hope these will help

Chun San
